name: n8n-nodes-kynth
description: Kynth Core for n8n — 39 finished-job AI endpoints: documents to JSON, extraction, triage, research, moderation, and more. Task-named pricing, one credit wallet.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp nodes/KynthCore/kynth.svg dist/nodes/KynthCore/ && cp credentials/kynth.svg dist/credentials/ && npm run icons:check
scripts.icons:check: test -s dist/nodes/KynthCore/kynth.svg && test -s dist/credentials/kynth.svg || (echo '⛔ icon missing from dist — the node would publish iconless again (see the 2026-08-17 n8n manual review)' && exit 1)
